variants.name: screen-validation-verification
variants.description: Deterministic receipt for the final per-screen matrix, scoped-memory controls, process provenance, and certification bundle

variants.name: certification-bundle
variants.description: Manifest, raw report, regenerated rendered report, and fresh-process transcript bound to the tested source

notes: A fresh CI=1 run at f8e203b6 completed all 20 product-screen scenarios and all 12 cross-screen, local-first, and chat scenarios.
Frozen root and nested frontend installs retained lock hashes 645e3af8... and 43c00bbf... before the source build and browser run.
The Providers scenario changed the default route, observed the alternate default, and restored the original default.
Global, agent, and user MCP memory scopes were observed explicitly; JWT and same-tenant two-user isolation include typed paired denial observations.
All 32 videos are unique playable H.264 MP4s with positive duration; all 54 artifact hashes and byte counts replay.
The report was regenerated after the transcript and Git-tree fingerprint were added to the finalized bundle manifest.
The first source-bound run failed because the exact-answer locator included a valid sibling A2UI artifact; the final run targets only the assistant text part without weakening the regex.

The repository mint helper cannot copy VP8 into MP4, reads ffmpeg input from its filename stream, and collapses repeated video.webm basenames; a temporary corrected runner produced 32 unique H.264 outputs without changing repository source.
The bundle records the tested source; a subsequent immutable receipt records the first evidence commit because a commit cannot contain its own hash.

The operator approved the corrected plan before execution, while immutable KBD decision screen-validation-plan-projection-lag records that canonical plan revision 7 was projected after the three repairs.
